d: Short, styled brown hair with a distinct platinum white streak in the front, paired with a groomed brown beard and mustache. Sharp, narrow amber eyes with a stern expression on a mature, weathered face. A muscular, athletic build wearing a teal blue scale-mail tabard with gold buckles over a tan tunic, grey trousers, and dark brown leather boots.
